# Kautusan Bayan sa Laang-Gugulin No. 01, Series of 1998

**Appropriation Ordinance for 1999 Expenditures**

## Summary

This ordinance authorizes the appropriation of funds amounting to Sixteen Million Two Hundred Twenty-Three Thousand Nine Hundred Ninety-Two and 84/100 Pesos (₱16,223,992.84) from the municipality's Internal Revenue Allotment (IRA) for various expenditures in 1999. It details specific allocations for different purposes and takes effect on January 1, 1999. The ordinance was enacted by the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] of Pitogo, Quezon.

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section 1.** Appropriates ₱16,223,992.84 from the IRA to cover various expenditures, as detailed, in accordance with [[Sec-17-RA7160|Section 17]] of [[RA-7160]].
2.  **Section 2.** Allocates funds for each of the thirty-nine (39) barangays in Teang Ligbong Piso (₱1,000.00) each.
3.  **Section 3.** Allocates funds for the position of Utility Worker I and Driver I in the [[Tanggapan ng Sangguniang Bayan]].
4.  **Section 4.** Allocates funds for ACA or Additional Compensation Allowance at a uniform allowance from the local treasury.
5.  **Section 5.** Allocates funds from the karagdagang pondo para sa RATA ng mga Punong Bayan sa bumbu ng Sangguniang Bayan.
6.  **Section 6.** Allocates funds for the intende ng Gugulong-Gulong na Punong Bayan para sa taong [[1999]] ay isinaaayos at ginagawang karagdagang bahagi ng kautusang ito na sinarkahang Annex "A".
7.  **Section 7.** This Ordinance shall take effect on January 1, [[1998]].
8.  **Section 8.** This Ordinance was approved on December 7, [[1998]] in Pitogo, Quezon.
